title: Specialized Support Button & Pure White Theme
author: Cold Winters Dev Team
summary: This update introduces a high-profile Support Us card alongside live news polling and full-screen release note reading.
changes: Converted Support Us link into a glowing pink card.
Switched standard active states to pure white.
Implemented dynamic news reading modal overlays.
fullArticle: We have overhauled the layout based on community feedback. The Support Us section now has a high-visibility sponsor badge and glow effect. Standard navigation tabs now feature high-contrast pure white highlights. You can now also click any news item to open its full article modal view.

title: Changelog Drawer Launch
author: Cold Winters Lead
summary: Added a live side drawer that fetches release notes directly from JSON.
changes: Integrated live polling and local read tracking.
fullArticle: Our live news system allows instant site updates without requiring full platform reloads.
